item.title: Lancers gut out defensive win at Sierra
item.description: The East Union Lancers got all they could handle plus more from cross-town rival Sierra on Saturday afternoon, pulling away late after trailing in the third quarter to secure a 39-26 victory and move to 3-0 in Valley Oak League play.

item.title: ROUNDUP: Lancers bury nine 3-pointers to knock off Oakdale
item.description: East Union’s girls basketball team hit five of its nine made 3-pointers during a game-changing second-quarter barrage en route to a 56-27 drubbing of visiting Oakdale on Monday.

item.title: Spencer’s 2nd-half assists lift Manteca to comfortable win over EU
item.description: Makayla Spencer felt a little off her game in the first half on Monday when she and Manteca tangled with rival East Union at Dino Cunial Stadium. So, she asked coach Justin Coenenberg for an additional 5-minute break coming out of halftime with the visiting Buffaloes nursing a one-goal lead. East Union pushed for the equalizer and came really close to getting it while Manteca’s midfield maestro watched from the sideline.

item.title: Gov. Newsom’s CPUC keeps Chinese buying green cards whole & rich at expense of PG&E ratepayers
item.description: Gavin Newsom’s administration has done the impossible. It’s managed to put Donald Trump and Joe Biden on the same page when it comes to a green energy project.

item.title: Hobby Lobby done deal; trampoline park opening soon
item.description: Business in Manteca is taking a big bounce — literally. Altitude Trampoline Park is getting ready to open on the northwest corner of Spreckels Avenue and Norman Drive across from Target in space that housed a seasonal Halloween costume store after Sears Appliances closed.

item.title: Teen driver arrested in Lathrop on loaded firearm charge
item.description: The Lathrop Police Department reported last week that a juvenile driver was arrested on felony charges including possession of a loaded firearm with high-capacity magazines.

item.title: Lathrop may add red light traffic cameras
item.description: Lathrop may be the next city to have red-light safety cameras at multiple locations around town, following Manteca and other cities.

item.title: Manteca continues effort to remove TCP from drinking water
item.description: Manteca has been effectively removing TCP from municipal well water over the past decade.

item.title: SJ County may help assist Thomas Toy Center, Boys & Girls Club with $35,000
item.description: San Joaquin County Supervisor Sonny Dhaliwal is helping secure $35,000 for non-profits working with Manteca youth.

item.title: MANTECA STARTS 818 MORE HOMES IN 2025
item.description: Manteca builders started 818 single family homes in 2025.
